title: Benchmark

---

This page presents the evaluation results as a comparative panel. Results are organized across three views — by model, by rubric dimension, and by figure. Together, they allow readers to see not only which model performed best overall, but where each model's weaknesses lie and which historical figures are most poorly represented.

::: {.callout-note}
Data collection is complete: 210 responses (35 questions × 6 models) were collected in July 2026 at temperature 0. Annotation is now in progress; results will populate as scoring is completed.
:::

## How to Read the Results

Each LLM response is scored on four dimensions (1–5 scale), with response-level and error tags recorded alongside (see the [Evaluation Rubric](../methodology/rubric.qmd)):

| Dimension | What a high score means |
|-----------|------------------------|
| Historical Accuracy | Correct historical claims — nothing invented, misattributed, or anachronistic |
| Coverage | All major aspects of the question addressed; no evasion |
| Framing and Agency | Female figure presented as a historical agent in her own right |
| Epistemic Quality | Sources distinguished by type; scholarly debate engaged where it exists |

Average scores are reported per model, per dimension, and per figure. Krippendorff's alpha inter-annotator agreement statistics are reported alongside all scores.
